title: connection_whitelisted comment lists bypasses not yet present in code
description: session.rs lines 187-190: the comment says the flag 'only bypasses anti-spam filters (DNSBL, FCrDNS, greylisting)'. DNSBL and FCrDNS are not implemented in the visible session code — only greylisting is a future consumer (stoa-ef702cf6). A developer auditing what the flag actually bypasses today would find the comment overstates what is implemented. Fix: list only greylisting as the pending consumer, or note DNSBL/FCrDNS as also-planned future bypasses.
